treatment_plan.notes: Follow-up for discomfort. Instructions for follow-up consultation for discomfort include chewing a cotton roll for 40 minutes and not brushing teeth and gargling for 24 hours. You can eat and drink after 2 hours. It is recommended that the food should not be too hot.

source_handle: 8. Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient. The patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local iodine disinfection and local infiltration anesthesia with 4% articaine are performed. After the anesthetic takes effect, the gums are separated, and the loose and affected teeth are extracted. Routinely scratch and scrape the extraction socket, reset the extraction socket, and apply cotton ball compression to stop bleeding.
